career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but automation and fitting. Platforms absorb manual work, while researchers who can model and explain results become more secure.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, astronomers still decide which questions to ask, how to define models, and how to judge evidence. Exploration continues to depend on human thought, writing, and accountability.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 + 拟合」——手工被平台吃，会建模能解释的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 pipelines + 拟合」——系统替人工测光、自动建模，但提问题、定模型、判证据仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，问什么问题、怎么定模型、证据怎么判，最后还是天文的脑去想、手去写、责去负——探索这头，人撤不干净。

risks: Oil odors and noise create physical strain
Button-only work without offset skills is replaced

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable the system becomes, people still correct a misaligned workpiece and respond when a dull tool causes a collision. career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化上下料 + 一人多机」——纯看管在消失，精度手艺在升值。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化上下料 + 一人多机」——桁架和机器人把上下料接管，单台看管岗位在合并；纯按键不补刀的人最先被挤。

一人多机拉大管理半径

Machinery replaces the work more readily

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how much machinery reduces strain, people still fill gaps, coordinate crews, and watch site safety. Construction depends on workers' hands, feet, and attention. Use this for career exploration, not diagnosis, hiring, or employment decisions.

career_path_block.说明: Entry-level role, easily replaced by automation
Stable but subject to homogeneous competition
Rising value in the AI era

career_risk_cards.callout: This occupation's greatest risk truly is AI, but only for operators who merely start instruments and read values. Advancing into quality control, retesting, result interpretation, and instrument management lets AI finish repetitive work while you focus on more valuable judgment.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is automation. Fully automated lines, AI image recognition, and remote review gradually replace repetitive work involving watching instruments and entering results. Workers who only follow instrument procedures have diminishing bargaining power.
risks: Automated lines and AI order review replace pure operating roles
Night shifts and prolonged standing create physical strain
Liability risk from specimen and result errors
Slow professional-title advancement and a clear income ceiling

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can read hundreds of results in one second, but an obviously implausible value still needs someone willing to look again and ask why. Machines cannot replace that conscientious responsibility.

responsibilities: Operate laboratory instruments to complete testing
Review abnormal results and perform retesting

career_path_block.说明: 入门岗位，易被自动化替代

career_risk_cards.callout: 这个职业最大的风险确实是 AI——但只针对「只会开机读数的操作员」。往质控、复检、结果解读和仪器管理上走，AI 反而帮你把重复活干完，让你专注在更值钱的判断上。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险正是自动化：全自动流水线、AI 图像识别、远程审核正在把「看仪器、录结果」的重复劳动逐渐替代，只会按部就班操作机器的人，议价空间在变小。
risks: 自动化流水线与 AI 审单替代纯操作岗位
夜班与长时间站立，身体消耗大
标本与结果差错的责任风险
职称晋升慢，收入天花板明显
生物安全暴露风险，需严格防护

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能一秒钟读出几百个结果，但那个「明显不符合常理」的数值，需要一个肯多看一眼的人去追问一句「为什么」——这份较真，是机器替代不了的责任心。

responsibilities: 操作检验仪器完成检测
skills: 实验室信息化系统使用

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but equipment + greener methods. Systems absorb trapping, while people with assessment skills become more resilient.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is green pest management + automated equipment. Trapping and monitoring devices replace some manual work, while on-site trace inspection and pesticide safety still require people. Chemical safety also creates substantial pressure.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable the equipment becomes, pest control workers still interpret traces, select treatments, and protect safety. Their eyes inspect, their hands place treatments, and their voices explain precautions, making people indispensable in pest management.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「设备 + 绿色化」——诱捕被系统吃，有研判力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「绿色治理 + 自动化设备」——诱捕与监测设备替代部分人工，但现场查迹与施药安全仍要人；同时药剂安全压力大。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管设备多聪明，踪迹怎么读、药怎么选、安全怎么守，最后还是防治员的眼去看、手去布、嘴去叮嘱——灭害这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but intelligent sorting + dispatch. Systems absorb administrative work, while people with coordination ability become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is intelligent sorting + dispatch systems. Automated lines accelerate sorting and digitalization reduces administrative work, but community mobilization and multi-party coordination still require people.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, coordinators still use their communication, planning, and judgment to decide which groups to mobilize, how to persuade them, and how to align multiple parties. People cannot be fully removed from environmental work.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「智能分拣 + 调度」——事务被系统吃，有协调力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「智能分拣 + 调度系统」——自动线把分拣提速，且数据化压缩事务；但社区动员与多方协调仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪类群体值得动员、怎么讲通、多方怎么协调，最后还是协调员的嘴去说、手去排、脑去判——环保这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but depletion. Teachers who only explain problems without developing educational skill feel more insecure with age. A durable career requires continuous growth in teaching research, assessment design, and student development.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest pressure is not AI, but progression pressure plus homeroom administration. Rankings, anxious parents, and adolescent problems all fall on teachers, creating substantial emotional strain.
risks: Progression pressure: achievement directly tied to targets
Family-school conflict: excessive demands and unclear boundaries create strain
Burnout: repetitive teaching and emotional depletion coexist
School-age population changes: jobs contract in some areas

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can write a standard lesson plan, but a student who hesitates outside the office before gathering the courage to ask for a conversation does not need a standard answer. This trust cannot be automated and is why the profession exists.

responsibilities: Serve as homeroom teacher and manage the class
Communicate with families and provide progression guidance

career_path_block.说明: 被 AI 与竞争双重挤压

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「被消耗」——只当讲题机器、不经营育人能力，年龄越大越慌；想干得久，得往教研、命题、育人方向持续积累。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的压力不是 AI，而是「升学压力加班主任杂务」——成绩排名、家长焦虑、青春期学生问题全都压在身上，情绪消耗非常大。
risks: 升学压力：成绩与指标直接挂钩
班主任杂务多，时间被无限切碎
家校矛盾：要求多、边界不清时心累
职业倦怠：重复教学与情绪消耗并存
学龄人口变化：部分地区岗位收缩

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能写出标准的教案，但那个在办公室门口犹豫半天、最后鼓起勇气说「老师我能聊聊吗」的学生，要的从来不是标准答案——这是机器代替不了的信任，也是这个职业存在的理由。

responsibilities: 完成学科教学与作业批改
承担班主任与班级管理
开展家校沟通与升学指导

career_path_block.说明: Low professional threshold and low ceiling

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk for social workers is not AI, but burnout and the income ceiling. AI can reduce documentation burdens, but long-term persistence amid low pay and slow change depends on professional identity and self-care.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but burnout and the income ceiling. Social workers confront long-term, complex social problems with slow results and frequent setbacks, creating substantial emotional strain. Pay is generally low and advancement paths limited, so many practitioners persist through commitment and turnover remains high.
risks: Low income: overall pay is low to moderate
Burnout: results are slow and setbacks frequent
Emotional strain: extensive contact with people in hardship
Limited advancement: organizations have flat hierarchies
Safety risks: visits and crisis sites

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can organize records, match policies, and generate reports, but only repeated home visits can reveal whether an older adult will accept help and how to build trust with a family. Machines cannot replace this work or the responsibility social workers carry for clients.

responsibilities: Assess client needs and establish files
Develop and implement case service plans
Connect policy resources and support implementation
Conduct visits, community activities, and coordination

career_path_block.说明: 职业化门槛低、天花板低

career_risk_cards.callout: 社工最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「倦怠与收入天花板」——AI 能减轻你的文书负担，但能否在低薪和慢变量里长期坚持，靠的是专业认同和自我照顾。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「职业倦怠与收入天花板」：面对的是长期性、复杂性的社会问题，成效慢、反复多，情绪消耗大；同时社工薪资普遍不高、晋升通道有限，很多从业者靠情怀坚持，流失率一直偏高。
risks: 收入偏低：整体薪资中等偏下
职业倦怠：成效慢、反复多
情绪消耗：接触大量困境人群
晋升有限：机构层级扁平
安全风险：走访与危机现场

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能整理记录、匹配政策、生成报告，但「这位老人愿不愿意接受帮助、这个家庭的信任该怎么建立」——这些只能发生在一趟趟上门探访里，机器替不了，也替不了社工为服务对象扛下的那份责任。

responsibilities: 评估服务对象需求并建档
制定执行个案服务计划
链接政策资源并协助落实
开展探访、社区活动与协同

career_path_block.说明: Period of building technical skills and credentials
Design and commissioning skills command a premium
Fastest to be replaced by prefabrication

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but seasonality and physical demands. Yet certified installers with integrated-energy expertise gain broader opportunities in the age of energy-efficiency retrofits.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this occupation is not AI but seasonality and physical demands. Projects follow weather and completion schedules, rooftop work carries fall and burn risks, summer heat and winter cold are severe, and sustained high-intensity work requires considerable physical fitness.
risks: Rooftop work at height carries high safety risks
Clear peak and off-seasons cause winter income volatility
Outdoor work brings major weather and seasonal challenges
Special-operation qualification barriers and renewal costs
Low-skill construction work shrinks with prefabrication

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate area, lay out piping, and report faults, but collectors must still be mounted on roofs one by one, pipes welded securely section by section, and systems repeatedly commissioned. Sunlight does not turn itself into hot water; human hands bridge the gap.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「淡旺季与体力」——但持证、懂综合能源的安装工，在节能改造时代反而越走越宽。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「淡旺季与体力」：工程跟着气候和竣工节点走，屋顶作业有坠落与烫伤风险，夏天暴晒、冬天挨冻，长期高强度对体力要求高。
risks: 屋顶高空作业，安全风险高
淡旺季明显，冬季收入波动
户外作业，天气与季节考验大
特种作业资质门槛与复审成本
低技能纯施工环节随预制化收缩

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能算面积、排管路、报故障，但集热板要一片片架上屋顶，管路要一段段焊严实，系统要一遍遍调到位——太阳不会自己变成热水，中间隔着一双手。

skills: 集热器安装与支架固定

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but automated steering. Steering is being absorbed, while people who command and accept responsibility become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's risks are automation and responsibility. Electronic navigation reduces some manual steering, but command decisions and legal accountability are difficult to replace. Shipping cycles fluctuate, and responsibility at sea is extremely heavy.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, operators still use their judgment, voice, and responsibility to decide what to do, issue orders, and manage emergencies. People cannot be removed completely from vessel safety.

responsibilities: Lead the crew and keep logs

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化操舵」——把舵被吃，能指挥能担责的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险是自动化与责任——电子导航压缩部分操舵，但指挥决策与法律责任难替；同时航运周期波动、海上责任极重。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，怎么决策、怎么下令、应急怎么扛，最后还是驾驶员的脑去判、嘴去喊、肩去担——船安不安，人撤不干净。
